story_fr: Adjusted EBITDA a augmenté de 12% à 3,7 milliards de dollars.
quote: Adjusted EBITDA was $3.7 billion, an increase of 12% from the prior-year quarter.

story_fr: Le conseil a déclaré un dividende en espèces de 8,75 $ par action.
story_en: The Board declared a cash dividend of $8.75 per share.
quote: Our Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $8.75 per share, payable on September 30, 2024.

story_fr: Accrual de 365 M$ pour le règlement d’une question fiscale italienne.
story_en: Recorded a $365 million accrual for an Italian tax settlement.
quote: During the quarter, the Company recorded a $365 million accrual related to the proposed settlement of certain Italian indirect tax matters.

story_fr: Croissance des nuitées de 8 % dépassant les attentes.
story_en: Room night growth of 8% exceeded expectations.
quote: We are pleased to report third quarter room night growth of 8%, which exceeded our prior expectations, driven primarily by stronger performance in Europe.
